observation_indicators.observable_fil: Para sa Bayabas, itugma ang botanical name, bahagi at nakalistang gamit. Ipaliwanag ang hangganan at konsultasyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: For Bayabas, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagmumungkahing pakuluan ang dahon o gumamit ng wash, o maghintay bago ipasuri.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Suggests boiling the leaves or a wash, or waiting before assessment.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naitutugma ang Psidium guajava, talbos/dahon at nakalistang gamit, at ipinasusuri agad ang sugat ni Mara nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Matches Psidium guajava, leafy tops and listed use, and seeks prompt assessment of Mara’s wound without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naitutugma ang card ngunit kailangan ng paalala na dapat ipasuri agad ang nana o kumakalat na pamumula.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Matches the card but needs a prompt that pus or spreading redness needs prompt assessment.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagmumungkahing pakuluan ang dahon o gumamit ng wash, o maghintay bago ipasuri.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Suggests boiling the leaves or a wash, or waiting before assessment.
